citation: Cottet, Cantoni, Mansart, Alexander, Hébert, Zhigadlo, Karpinski & Carbone, "Quantitative imaging of flux vortices in type-II superconductor MgB2 using Cryo-Lorentz Transmission Electron Microscopy", arXiv:1401.4062v1 (2014)
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only
topic: Cryo-Lorentz TEM images of flux vortices in a 300 nm thick MgB2 lamella (pre-tilted by 45°) at 5 K, for fields between 50.8 and 188.7 G.

facts.text: Dark bands cross the images; inside them the vortex contrast is too weak to locate vortices.
Tilting the specimen slightly, or changing the field (which changes the imaging condition), changes the size and position of the dark bands.
The average vortex spacings measured in regions separated by the bands cross as the field rises, showing that vortices move from one region to another.
Between the bands the vortex arrangement becomes more triangular as the field rises (average six-fold order parameter 0.73 at 117.3 G).

ask: Which explanation of the dark bands is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: Bend contours: diffraction contrast where local bending of the thin crystal meets the Bragg condition; they hide vortices but do not change the vortex lattice.
hypotheses.locator: Results: bend contours due to diffraction contrast; crossing curves confirm they do not affect the lattice
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: Vortex-free Meissner domains of an intermediate (type-1.5) superconducting state.
hypotheses.locator: Introduction and Results: no stripes or gossamer patterns; conventional type-II behaviour
hypotheses.reason: 磁性的无涡旋畴不会随样品轻微倾转而移动，也不会被涡旋穿越。

hypotheses.text: Lines of strong pinning centres that hold the vortices in place.
hypotheses.locator: Results: no vortex pinning except at the edge
hypotheses.reason: 钉扎线是固定缺陷，不随倾转移动，且会阻止涡旋在区域间移动。

hypotheses.text: Ferromagnetic domains of a magnetic impurity phase in the crystal.
hypotheses.reason: 磁畴是样品的固有磁结构，不会因轻微倾转改变位置。

scale.definition: 涡旋间距（117.3 G 时约 0.45 μm）
